admin_tenants_id.confirmConvertToPaying:
Convert {name} to a paying customer?

This will:
• Mark the business as ACTIVE
• Set the next charge in 30 days
• Clear the trial days
• Generate the PENDING commission for the affiliate if one is assigned

Use only if the customer actually paid (outside of Hotmart).
admin_tenants_id.markAsPaidTitle: The customer paid outside of Hotmart — convert to an active customer and generate commission
admin_tenants_id.confirmDemoLock:
Enable demo mode (read-only)?

Nobody except super admin will be able to modify this business. Intended for demo accounts that ambassadors show to prospects.
admin_tenants_id.unlockDemoTitle: Remove the demo lock to edit the content again
admin_tenants_id.lockDemoTitle: Enable demo mode: read-only for non-super-admins
admin_tenants_id.demoModeActiveBody: Any user who enters this business (including owner or staff) can only view and browse — they cannot modify anything. Only super admin can edit. Unlock above if you need to update the curated content.
admin_tenants_id.confirmRefreshWallets:
Queue a refresh for ALL active wallets of this business?

This does NOT modify stamps / points / benefits — it only asks Apple / Google to re-download the updated .pkpass (useful after branding or design changes). Each wallet receives a silent background push.
admin_tenants_id.walletsRefreshDesc: Queues a push update for all active wallets of the business. Useful after changing branding (logo, colors, strip). It does not modify stamps or benefits — it only re-syncs the .pkpass design.
admin_tenants_id.walletsEnqueuedResult: {enqueued} of {total} wallets queued successfully. The refresh runs in the background (1-2 min on large tenants).
admin_tenants_id.whatsappMessagingDesc: Configure the phone numbers that route the business orders. The end customer does not see this section — only SUPER_ADMIN can edit it.
admin_tenants_id.orderToBusinessHelp: When a customer sends an order from the menu, wa.me opens to this number. If empty, it uses the main WhatsApp.
admin_tenants_id.businessToDeliveryHelp: When a delivery order payment is accepted, wa.me opens to this number with the summary and address ready to dispatch.
admin_tenants_id.tenantModulesDesc: Tutorials, academy and reservations module. Changes are reflected in the customer's sidebar on refresh.
admin_tenants_id.showTutorialsHelp: "🎓 Tutorials" link in the customer sidebar (academy.soyclubify.lat/cliente).
admin_tenants_id.showAcademyHelp: Reserved (per-tenant field for future use — the Academy for affiliates is always shown for now).
admin_tenants_id.enableReservationsHelp: Enables the reservations module (zones + tables + schedule) and the public flow /reserva/<slug>. When enabled, the "Reservations" section appears in the customer sidebar.
admin_tenants_id.noTrialModificationsHelp: Use "Manage Trial" from the list to add or subtract days.
admin_tenants_id.reviewAlertsAccountDesc: Choose which Grow Business subaccount to use for SMS when a customer leaves a low review for this business.
admin_tenants_id.billingAlertsAccountDesc: Choose which Grow Business subaccount to use for administrative SMS (D-1 reminder, non-payment, suspension).
admin_tenants_id.deliveryAlertsAccountDesc: Choose which Grow Business subaccount to use for SMS to delivery companies when a delivery order changes status.
admin_tenants_id.useBusinessOwnCredsHelp: Fallback to the Grow Business card above (credentials pasted individually for this tenant).
admin_tenants_id.reviewLogsDesc: Every time a customer leaves a low review, we record whether the SMS via Grow Business went out or failed.
admin_tenants_id.confirmSimulateEvent: Trigger {event} on this tenant? This does NOT involve real Hotmart.
admin_tenants_id.hotmartSimulatorDesc: Triggers webhook events against this tenant without involving Hotmart or charging anything. It goes through the same handler as a real payment.
admin_tenants_id.hotmartSimulatorFooter: Simulations mark the tenant with subscriberCode = sim-... to distinguish from real charges. If you want to simulate multiple renewals, use UPDATE_SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGE_DATE and then PURCHASE_APPROVED again.
admin_tenants_id.billingSmsSequenceDesc: Automatic SMS messages to the owner from the Grow Business subaccount. The daily cron (3 AM) triggers them according to the Hotmart cycle.
admin_tenants_id.noGrowBusinessWarning: ⚠ This business is not connected to Grow Business. Billing SMS are not sent — the emails that show in the cron stay in the log but do not reach the owner. Connect above in the "Grow Business · SMS" card.
admin_tenants_id.notifStep1Title: 🗓 D-1 reminder (one day before the charge)
admin_tenants_id.notifStep2Help: Sent upon receiving PURCHASE_APPROVED from the Hotmart webhook
admin_tenants_id.notifStep4Title: ⏰ Your account will be paused in 2 days
admin_tenants_id.notifStep4Help: Cron sends 2 days after the last failed attempt (failedPaymentCount={count})
admin_tenants_id.notifStep5Help: 4 days after the last failed attempt without payment, cron suspends the account
admin_tenants_id.priceCleared: Price cleared — reverts to the bundle's canonical value

admin_tenants_id.graceDaysAfterExpiryHelp: Extra days of access after the trial expires before locking. 0 = immediate cutoff.
admin_tenants_id.pendingModeNote: This deactivates the current code and re-enables the lockscreen. The owner will have to pay on Hotmart to enter again.
admin_tenants_id.freeModeNote: Account stays active as a courtesy indefinitely.
admin_tenants_id.realPriceLabel: Real price paid on Hotmart (commission base)
admin_tenants_id.realPriceHelp: Empty = uses the plan's canonical price (68/150/278/500). Set it if the business paid a different amount (e.g. old $50 link) so commissions are not overestimated.
admin_tenants_id.currentPlanDesc: Internal business metadata. The real charge is dictated by Hotmart.

admin_tenants_id.changeWarningIntro: Hotmart is NOT notified automatically — you have to:
admin_tenants_id.changeWarningStep1: Cancel the old subscription on Hotmart.
admin_tenants_id.changeWarningStep2: Send the customer the new plan link (Hotmart link configured in <link>/admin/branding</link>).
admin_tenants_id.changeWarningFooter: Without this, the charge will remain that of the previous plan.

admin_ai_knowledge.howItWorksP1: Each entry in this list feeds the AI assistant of the support widget that customers see in the panel. The backend takes all active entries, concatenates them into the Anthropic Claude (haiku) system prompt, and answers based on that.
admin_ai_knowledge.howItWorksP2: Keep entries short and to the point (200-500 words). A common question + a clear answer works better than a long tutorial. Group them by category to make them easier to maintain.
admin_ai_knowledge.emptyDesc: Add the first entry with frequently asked questions and answers. The AI assistant will start using the information as soon as you activate the entry.
admin_ai_knowledge.titleQuestionPlaceholder: E.g.: How to change a business's plan
admin_ai_knowledge.answerContentPlaceholder: E.g.: To change a business's plan, go to /admin/tenants/[id], find the "Billing" card and choose the mode (Paid / Trial / No payment). Applying the change updates the lockscreen state.
admin_ai_knowledge.markdownHint: Basic Markdown allowed. The AI uses this text as context when answering.
admin_ai_knowledge.importModalDesc: Paste a long document (FAQ, brief, landing copy) and the AI will automatically split it into individual knowledge base entries. You don't have to create each question-answer by hand.
admin_ai_knowledge.overwriteHint: If an entry with the same title already exists in this category, it is overwritten (not duplicated).
admin_ai_knowledge.documentPlaceholderSections:
## How do wallet cards work?
Clubify generates pkpass for Apple and JWT save links for Google...

## What happens if the customer changes phones?
The pass is restored automatically from iCloud...
admin_ai_knowledge.documentPlaceholderOther: Paste the document here. It will be split automatically according to the chosen mode.
admin_ai_knowledge.masterPromptDesc: Text prepended to the AI widget's system prompt. Useful to set tone, add specific instructions or restrictions without redeploying. If empty, only the default prompt + the knowledge base are used.
admin_ai_knowledge.masterPromptPlaceholder:
Example:
You are a Clubify assistant. You speak neutral LATAM Spanish. Never use Argentine slang. If the customer mentions prices without being logged in, redirect them to /signup. The single Elite plan at USD 50/month includes everything (wallet cards, WhatsApp automations, multi-location).
admin_ai_knowledge.voyageWarning: ⚠ Enable VOYAGE_API_KEY in Railway for semantic retrieval
admin_ai_knowledge.confirmDeleteDocument: Delete this document and its indexed chunks?
admin_ai_knowledge.knowledgeBaseDescPart1: Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD. The system parses them, splits them into chunks (~1500 chars with overlap), embeds them with Voyage AI (if
admin_ai_knowledge.knowledgeBaseDescPart2: is set) and queries them semantically. Without Voyage, retrieval is lexical. Each chunk inherits the document's audience — tenants see TENANT + BOTH docs; affiliates see AFFILIATE + BOTH.
admin_ai_knowledge.noDocumentsYet: No documents yet. Upload the first one to train the AI with your business info (manuals, scripts, compensation plan, etc).
admin_ai_knowledge.uploadModalDesc: PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD. Max 25MB. It is parsed + chunked + embedded (if Voyage AI is configured).
